# AXON.INTEL

> AI-powered news intelligence platform with multilingual feeds, semantic search, AI summaries, and a conversational news assistant grounded in retrieved articles (RAG).

## Pages
- [Intelligence Feed](/): Personalized daily news feed with filters for region, language, category, and time range.
- [Semantic Search](/search): Vector-embedding search across indexed articles.
- [News Assistant](/chat): Conversational RAG assistant grounded in the indexed news corpus.
- [Breaking Alerts](/alerts): Real-time breaking-news alerts.
